top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks combine the magic-wavelength principle with decisive, independently reproduced experimental realization, yielding a durable new precision-measurement regime. Katori and Ye provide the clearest compact attribution if the citation remains strictly confined to the invention and development of optical lattice clocks.
